PM Modi likens critics to 'Naraaz Fufa' at Delhi college event

Prime Minister Narendra Modi addressed students at a top Delhi college, likening habitual critics of the government to a "naraaz fufa" (angry uncle) who is perpetually displeased. He spoke to the students about life beyond campus and the importance of understanding different perspectives. The "naraaz fufa" analogy was used to describe those who are consistently critical without offering constructive solutions.
